# @sharadox/graphical-user-interface-web-library

> One generic React 19 component library. Every value has one source (CSS custom properties written by InterfaceStyle from defineInterface), everything else is derived with var(); brands only configure it.

- /interface-configuration: defineInterface({ colorStyles?, inheritColorStyles?, defaultColorStyle? ("inherit"), colors?: { [name]: { rgb: { white, black }, gradient?, on?, transparent?, hover? } | { of: name | { white, black }, on?, transparent?, hover? } }, cornerStyles?, defaultCornerStyle?, lineStyles?, defaultLineStyle?, scale?, breakpoints?, sizes?, defaultSize?, values? }) → InterfaceConfiguration; DEFAULT_INTERFACE; isReference(color)
- /style-sheet: interfaceStyleSheet(configuration) → CSS. Variables per color X: --X-color-rgb (source), --X-color-rgb-alpha, --X-color, --X-transparent-color-rgb, --X-transparent-color-rgb-alpha, --X-transparent-color, --X-transparent-hover-color, --X-transparent-active-color, --X-border-color, --X-on-color(-rgb), --X-hover-color(-rgb), --X-color-paint, --X-color-gradient (optional). A piece's color: --current-* (same names). Shared: --scale-{0,4,8,12,14,16,24,32,64,128}, --breakpoint-{640,960,1280}, --color-rgb-alpha, --transparent-color-rgb-alpha (10%), --transparent-hover-color-rgb-alpha, --transparent-active-color-rgb-alpha, --disabled-opacity, --line-thickness, --line-style, --corner-radius, --quick-duration (0.1s), --duration (0.25s), --easing, --glass-blur, --current-{minimum-size,font-size,font-weight,field-font-weight,section-padding}, --wrapper-width, --wrapper-padding. Attributes: data-style-color (white|black|inherit), data-style-corner (square|rounded-square|circle), data-style-line (line|dotted|dashed), data-color, data-size (small|medium|large), data-variant, data-direction, data-justify, data-align, data-text-align, data-gap, data-padding; each also as data-<name>-<breakpoint>.
- /interface-style: InterfaceStyle({ configuration }) — <style> with the sheet, in the root layout's head
- /responsive: responsiveAttributes(name, value | { base?, [width]: value }, fallback?) → { [data-name(-width)]: string }
- /box-axis: boxAxes(scale) → Axis[] ({ attribute, values: { [name]: { rest, hover?, active? } } }); VARIANT_AXIS, DIRECTION_AXIS, JUSTIFY_AXIS, ALIGN_AXIS, TEXT_ALIGN_AXIS, BOX_INITIAL_VALUES
- /box: Box({ as?, variant?: filled|outlined|transparent|inline, color?, colorStyle?, corner?, line?, size?, direction?: left-to-right|right-to-left|top-to-bottom|bottom-to-top, justify?, align?, textAlign?, gap?, padding? (each Responsive), prefix?, suffix?, square?, interactive?, state?: enabled|hover|active|loading|disabled, ...element }); flex, centered both axes and text by default
- /spinner: Spinner({ className? }) — 8 bars, clockwise trail, 1em, aria-hidden
- /button: Button({ variant? (filled), color? (brand), size?, corner?, line?, colorStyle?, state?, loading?, disabled?, icon?, square?, prefix?, suffix?, ...button }) or with href: next/link Link (or link component), disabled link has no href and aria-disabled; BUTTON_AXES
